notes: Zertal 2005 Site 8 (Khellalyel Madkhul (2); entry grid 1954/2012 is the unit point exactly) describes wall sections and sherd concentrations of an Early Muslim village. It describes no pool, pit or grave, so features is empty. The water source is 'Ein Mukehaz, 1 km away, a spring. The entry has no site plan. The header field 'Cisterns: none' is recorded as an explicit C2 absence, but it covers cisterns only.
